cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The dishwasher's broken. Excellent: we'll serve the curry in rolls. No plates to wash.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are twelve guests and only six rolls.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Halve them. Open sandwiches: twice the servings, same bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hollow them out first. Edible bowls, and the crumbs thicken the curry. We've saved the flour too.

mechanism: A uses precise cooking corrections to turn appliance failure, too little bread and runny curry into an increasingly efficient edible-serving routine.
confusable: Generic resourcefulness solves reluctantly; A must celebrate each problem as a new saving or smarter process.
comparison: Stairs alternative combines chores with fitness; curry alternative turns serving containers and waste crumbs into cooking ingredients.
seedUse: Dishwasher, six rolls for twelve and runny curry derive from D44-b; S03 strengthens the cutting and hollowing instructions.
